analysis.reasonEn: Maintaining a wait-and-see stance for 3 consecutive trading days. RSI entering oversold territory, ADX trend is weak. A Higher Low pattern is forming with the 5-day low at 51,750 KRW and the 20-day low at 51,065 KRW. While the MACD histogram shows improvement, the weekly RSI at 35.4 and weekly MACD histogram at -7471.1859 indicate continued weakness. The 52-week position at 7.8% is near historical lows. With an ATR of 6,753 KRW, a stop loss of 1.3x ATR (8,778 KRW) would set the stop at 45,687 KRW from an entry of 54,465 KRW, and a target at 73,243 KRW (1.5 risk-reward ratio), but waiting for trend confirmation is prudent.
